marcadores.explicacao_original: Liver sinusoids are the most leaky capillaries, due to the presence of endothelial cells fenestrations, gaps between adjacent cells and an incomplete basal lamina that does not cover the fenestrations or gaps. Surrounding each sinusoid is the space of Disse, filled with hepatocyte microvilli.
